summary: Burgers is retired from the Launchpad research path, completing the change the Challenge-campaign adapter named as next. The Challenge registry lists Burgers as RETIRED and refuses to resolve it with challenge_retired; there is no default Challenge, so a launch that names none is refused with challenge_required, and campaign_for composes no Burgers campaign. A frozen campaign from before Challenges were named is the retired Burgers campaign: resuming it is refused, while observe, pause, stop and reconcile still work. The stdio attach composes only through a Challenge's own registered campaign. Lifecycle tests run on a development-fixture Challenge registered only for the test's duration. The Burgers code stays in the repository as reference and no scientific, evaluation or disclosure rule changes.
